learning_outcomes.text: Expressing themselves at the beginning level.

syllabus_topics: Hi. My name is… - “This is me” (listening)
Greeting and saying goodbye - Introducing yourself and others by name; introduction
Asking and answering origin-related questions - Naming the countries and languages - Letters - A dialogue about asking someone on the phone
Personal cards: Name, surname, town, country - Filling in a registration form
My Family - Break is great (listening) - Asking and answering the question of “how are you?” (formal and informal phrases)
Introducing family members - Possessive pronouns: mein/e, dein/e, Ihr/e - Asking someone’s place - Personal pronouns: ich, du, er, sie, es, wir, ihr, sie

Understanding and writing numbers from 0 to 100 - Reading and writing telephone numbers - Wh- Questions and their answers: Understanding the personal information on the form and filling in the form with personal information
German-speaking countries - Reading: My family and me - Game: Giving information about people and understanding such information
Eating and Drinking, Modal verbs - “Banana pancake” (listening) - Indefinite/Negative articles: ein/eine/kein/keine - Nouns without articles
Naming things/objects - Plural nouns - Yes/ No Questions: Questions starting with a verb
Expressing quantity - Shopping dialogues at the supermarket or bazaar - Asking the price; units of weight and measurement (kg, gr, bottle, pocket etc.)
Eating and drinking, irregular verbs - Place prefixes, dative case - Expressing likes (like/dislike)
Recipe: Grandfather’s Patato Salad - “Oh, I see!” (listening) - Parts of the house
Describing people/house/apartment - Adjectives and their antonyms - Definite articles: der, die, das, die (plural) - General Revision
